comment: Le Grand Casino Janus (designs/job2-casino.md): the heist's second job, written by tools/levelgen/build_casino.py (edit that, not this file). A Monte-Carlo-style casino on three levels: the place, the atrium, the Salle Renaissance (slots), the Salle Europe (tables, the pit, one-way glass), the cage and its mantrap, back of house, security; the eye-in-the-sky catwalks, the surveillance room, the executive suite and the Salons Prives with their sea terrace above; the house vault, the count rooms, the goods lift and the plant below. x east, z north.
